community.heading: Support Our Work
community.text: Part of our mission is giving back to the next generation of legal and financial professionals. We offer internship placements for law and accounting students, giving them real-world experience alongside our team. If you'd like to partner with us or support this work, we'd love to hear from you.
community.ctaWhatsappText: Hi AELFC, I'd like to learn more about partnering with you or supporting your internship program.
